recursion-1.alt: Calls to factorial go down to the base case and the answers come back up
recursion-1.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 520 250" role="img" aria-label="Calls to factorial go down to the base case and the answers come back up"><defs><marker id="recursion-1-arG" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" class="mk-g"></path></marker></defs>
      <text x="130" y="20" text-anchor="middle" class="s b">CALLS GO DOWN ↓</text>
      <text x="400" y="20" text-anchor="middle" class="s g">ANSWERS COME BACK UP ↑</text>
      <rect x="20" y="32" width="220" height="40" rx="11" class="f-b"></rect><text x="34" y="57" class="m">factorial(4) = 4 × factorial(3)</text>
      <rect x="40" y="82" width="220" height="40" rx="11" class="f-b"></rect><text x="54" y="107" class="m">factorial(3) = 3 × factorial(2)</text>
      <rect x="60" y="132" width="220" height="40" rx="11" class="f-b"></rect><text x="74" y="157" class="m">factorial(2) = 2 × factorial(1)</text>
      <rect x="80" y="182" width="220" height="40" rx="11" class="f-a"></rect><text x="94" y="207" class="m">factorial(1) = 1   ← base case</text>
      <path d="M318 202 C370 202 380 162 340 152" class="ln-g" marker-end="url(#recursion-1-arG)"></path><text x="380" y="190" class="m s g">returns 1</text>
      <path d="M298 152 C360 152 370 112 320 102" class="ln-g" marker-end="url(#recursion-1-arG)"></path><text x="372" y="140" class="m s g">returns 2 × 1 = 2</text>
      <path d="M278 102 C340 102 350 62 300 52" class="ln-g" marker-end="url(#recursion-1-arG)"></path><text x="352" y="90" class="m s g">returns 3 × 2 = 6</text>
      <text x="300" y="44" class="m s g">→ 4 × 6 = 24</text>
    </svg>
